description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) named LeaveWithDaysLeft within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates data related to an employee's leave, including properties like leave ID, date, duration, status, leave type, employee number, and days left. It provides constructor and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: LeaveWithDaysLeft
classes.description: A DTO class representing leave details with additional information about days left for the leave.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties of the leave object.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the leave.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the leave.

methods.name: getLengthHours
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: setLengthHours
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in hours.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the duration of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the duration of leave in days.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the leave.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the leave.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee's number associated with the leave.

methods.name: getDaysLeft
methods.description: Returns the number of days left for the leave.

methods.name: setDaysLeft
methods.description: Sets the number of days left for the leave.
